name: help
stdout:
BusyBox v1.39.0.git (<TIMESTAMP>) multi-call binary.

Usage: i2cset [-fy] [-m MASK] BUS CHIP-ADDRESS DATA-ADDRESS [VALUE] ... [MODE]

Set I2C registers

	I2CBUS	I2C bus number
	ADDRESS	0x03-0x77
MODE is:
	c	Byte, no value
	b	Byte data (default)
	w	Word data
	i	I2C block data
	s	SMBus block data
	Append p for SMBus PEC

	-f	Force access
	-y	Disable interactive mode
	-r	Read back and compare the result
	-m MASK	Mask specifying which bits to write
